references.text: Parallel law text forbidding the eating of water creatures without fins and scales, declaring them unclean
Describes which water creatures are permitted to eat—those with fins and scales—as a contrast to this prohibition
Previous verse specifying which sea creatures are allowed to be eaten, namely those with fins and scales
Peter's vision in which God declares all animals clean, overturning the Old Testament food laws regarding clean and unclean animals
Jesus teaches that it is not what enters a person from outside that makes them unclean, relating to the ancient purity laws
